rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:81958296F73300000000}When I look at you,
I'm reminded of a man
named Char Aznable.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296F83300000000}Char Aznable, sir?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296F93300000000}He hid his past for his ambitions
and covered his face with a mask,
but vanished with his goal only half achieved.

{C:81958296FA3300000000}Of course, I'm not saying
that's who you are.
It's your mask that reminds me of him.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296FB3300000000}In the sense of hiding my past,
perhaps we are alike.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296FC3300000000}Someday, I'd like to meet you without the mask
and have a leisurely talk,
Zechs Merquise.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296FD3300000000}Yes, I would, too,
Captain Quattro.




{x00}

{C:81932201}{C:81958296603100000000}I'll enter the information, so head for the 
{C:819782830300}Liberation Front Base{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296613100000000}Input confirmed.
I'll display it on the radar.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296623100000000}Is {C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} on the other side?
Wouldn't it be better
to go straight there?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296633100000000}We should get a grasp of the situation.
As Eiji says,
we should head for the Liberation Front Base.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296643100000000}Well, you heard him.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296653100000000}Yes.



{x00}

Let's head for the Liberation Front Base.
We need to get information first.

rows.en:
{C:81905002}{C:81958296673100000000}Head for the Liberation Front Base.

{C:81904202}{C:81958296683100000000}You're {C:819782830400}Muller{C:819782830000}!!
What are you doing here!?

{C:81904402}{C:81958296693100000000}Waaah!
Why is Muller here?
What do we do, Roddy, Barts!?

{C:81901C00}{C:819582966B3100000000}Is he someone you know?

{C:81904302}{C:819582966C3100000000}He's the old guy
who keeps chasing us.
I can't believe he came all this way.

{C:81905002}{C:819582966D3100000000}Our battle is on hold.
Right now, there's something more important to do.

{C:819582966E3100000000}Eiji, our comrades have been captured.
I want to go and rescue them first.
Will you help?

{C:81902201}{C:819582966F3100000000}Of course.
Who's been captured?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296703100000000}David and Anna.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296713100000000}What!?

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296723100000000}They've taken hostages!?
What are the proud people of Grados
doing!?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296733100000000}There are no demands.
They just intend to kill them as an example.

{C:81958296743100000000}Let's set out to rescue them at once.
I know where they are,
so I'll come with you.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81932401}{C:81958296753100000000}Are you all right, {C:819782830400}Anna?{C:819782830000}

{C:81932301}{C:81958296763100000000}Yes.

{C:81932401}{C:81958296773100000000}It looks like this is the end for us.
I'm sorry you have to die with me of all people.

{C:81932301}{C:81958296783100000000}David, don't give up.
I'm sure he'll come. Eiji will come for us.


{C:81932401}{C:81958296793100000000}Will he?
He's been missing all this time.

{C:81932301}{C:819582967A3100000000}I'm sure Eiji will come for us.



{x00}

{C:81935002}{C:819582967B3100000000}We're heading for {C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000}!

{C:8193A002}{C:819582967C3100000000}We're going straight for their headquarters?
Isn't that far too reckless!?

{C:81935002}{C:819582967D3100000000}The execution will take place
in ruins near Grados.
We have to go.

{C:81930300}{C:819582967E3100000000}Everyone, we may face battle
as soon as we arrive.
Take your positions.



{x00}

{C:81935E02}{C:81958296803100000000}Those people from Terra
are pretty generous, aren't they?
This is a fine ship, even if it's old.

{C:81935F02}{C:81958296813100000000}I suppose your threats worked, Colonel.

{C:81935E02}{C:81958296823100000000}Don't spoil it.
We just requisitioned it because we needed it.

{C:81936102}{C:81958296833100000000}Either way,
the enemy's approaching.
It's our old friend, the Astante II.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296843100000000}I've got a proposal.
Do you want to hear it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296853100000000}What is it?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296863100000000}How about
Jet, Faye and I
go and rescue the hostages?

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296873100000000}Hey, hold on. You want me to go, too?

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296883100000000}I don't want to, either.
Why should I have to
do something so tiring?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296893100000000}I don't like freeloading.
You don't have to come if you don't want to.
Anyway, I'm doing it.

{C:819582968A3100000000}Ed, give us a diversion
when we get off the ship.

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582968B3100000000}Yes, yeees!
You can leave it to meee!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C3100000000}I'll leave the rescue operation entirely to you,
but be careful, Spike.

{C:8193CA02}{C:819582968D3100000000}Thanks.


{x00}

{C:81936202}{C:819582968F3100000000}Whaaat?
The instruments have gone haywire!

{C:81935E02}{C:81958296903100000000}You idiot!!
The enemy might get away.
Hurry up and fix them!

{x00}

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296913100000000}Well then, I'm off.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296923100000000}It can't be helped.
I'll come with you.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296933100000000}Ugh, what a pain.
Oh, and don't lose.
I'd hate to have nowhere to come back to.


{x00}

{C:81932201}{C:819582969B3100000000}Anna, I'm sorry
I'm so late...

{C:81932301}{C:819582969D3100000000}It's all right... Eiji...
You've come back to us.

{C:81932401}{C:819582969E3100000000}You...!
Where have you been all this time?

{C:81932201}{C:819582969F3100000000}I've found some friends.
We've kept on fighting all this time.
They're all good people.


{x00}

{C:819782830300}briefing room{C:819782830000}.

rows.en:
{C:81902401}{C:81958296A13100000000}I'm David Rutherford.
This is Anna Stephanie.
You already know Muller, right?

{C:81958296A33100000000}There are a lot of others,
so I'll keep this brief:
they're nine members of the Defense Class.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296A53100000000}Did you say Defense Claaass!?
Where? Where are they!?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296A63100000000}Is everyone safe?

{C:81902401}{C:81958296A73100000000}Who are these brats?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83100000000}They're Defense Class members, too.
Could you tell them where the others are?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296A93100000000}Those kids?
I think they were playing on the outskirts.

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296AA3100000000}May we go and see them?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296AB3100000000}There's no need to hold back.
Go and see them right away.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296AC3100000000}Thanks, Professor.
Koji, Asuka, let's go!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902401}{C:81958296AD3100000000}Then let's load up our belongings.
Now that Eiji's back,
we've no more use for this place.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296AE3100000000}What do you mean?

{C:81902301}{C:81958296AF3100000000}We'd decided that
once Eiji returned, we'd attack 
{C:819782830300}Grados Tower{C:819782830000}.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B03100000000}Grados Tower
is the enemy's strongpoint, then?

{C:81902301}{C:81958296B23100000000}Yes.
We were captured
when we went to investigate it, though.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B33100000000}Then let's prepare to sortie.
I'll go back to the Astante II
ahead of you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B43100000000}Oh, I'll go back, too.

{C:81958296B53100000000}David,
please let everyone in the Defense Class
know, too.

{C:81902401}{C:81958296B63100000000}OK. Leave it to me.


{x00}

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B73100000000}Hey, you!
Stop flopping around
and carry the luggage properly!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296B83100000000}Meooow-laaa... flooop, flooop...

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B93100000000}Even I, the great Demon Prince,
am working!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296BA3100000000}Mmm... purrr... flooop, flooop...
It feels so gooood...


{x00}

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BB3100000000}I think you'd better
stop bothering her.
I'm sure she won't budge.

{C:8193A702}{C:81958296BC3100000000}Mrowww... purrr...

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BD3100000000}Don't you start slacking off too, Himikooo!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3100000000}You've already started loading?
Thanks, Wataru and Toraoh.




{x00}

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296BF3100000000}What are you people doing!?
Hurry up with the preparations!!
Hm? What happened to the Death Demon Squad?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296450100000000}SPTs, was it?
They went off with their machines.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C03100000000}What!?
Are they betraying me, too!?
I'll never forgive you! Never, Binzvanker!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296460100000000}You're so young.
That's why {C:819782830400}Binzvanker{C:819782830000}
can fool you.


{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C23100000000}What, woman!?
What did you just say!?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296470100000000}You get fooled because
you lose your temper so quickly.
Calm down and think things through.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C33100000000}Ghh...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C43100000000}Tail,
we've finished our preparations here!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296490100000000}We're done here, too.
Now we just have to wait for the Defense Class.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81907B02}{C:81958296C83100000000}Sorry to keep you waaaiting!
Listen to this!

{C:81958296C93100000000}Now that the whole Defense Class is here,
Ken-Oh, Ho-Oh and Ju-Oh can combine into 
{C:819782830400}Raijin-Oh{C:819782830000}!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3100000000}Rai...?

{C:81907E02}{C:81958296C23A00000000}Raijin-Oh.
They can combine
into a giant robot.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB3100000000}Um, are you a Defense Class member, too?

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964B0100000000}Yes. I'm the Defense Class commander, 
{C:819782830400}Maria Shiratori{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3100000000}To tell the truth, I don't want to drag
you kids into this.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296CD3100000000}Hey, we can fight, too!
You can't leave us out!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CE3100000000}I know.
I haven't stopped you before, have I?

{C:81958296CF3100000000}I think this will be the final battle.
So let's give it our all.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D03100000000}Of course!!
I'm counting on you and the others, Maria.

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964C0100000000}Of course!





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296D23100000000}There are so many more people all at once.
Are you all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D33100000000}I'm fine.
...I'm more worried about
the opponent waiting in Grados.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D43100000000}Are they that strong?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D53100000000}That's what Dad says.
They're someone you read about in history books.

{C:81958296D63100000000}It's scary to fight someone who can take on
Dad and the others on equal terms or better.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296D73100000000}You're naive, boy.
You'll die thinking like that.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D83100000000}I won't die.
I've got my friends, after all.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296D93100000000}With that spirit, you'll be all right.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DA3100000000}Haman seems
a little awkward with people.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3100000000}Yeah,
she was looking out for me.

{C:81958296DC3100000000}All right!
It's the final battle.
Let's get fired up!!



{x00}

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296DD3100000000}Well done, making it this far.
Out of respect for all that futile effort,
I'll fight you myself in {C:819782830400}Imakarum{C:819782830000}.


{x00}

The world is...

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E13100000000}It seems to be the enemy's power.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296E23100000000}Damn Binzvanker.
They've acquired a strange power.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296E33100000000}Perhaps they're even moving
the Cloud Sea with this power.

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296E43100000000}Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:81958296E53100000000}You've certainly earned your way here.
Then I suppose I'll
fight you seriously, too!!

{C:81958296E73100000000}But this isn't where the final battle will be.
{C:819782830300}Claudia{C:819782830000} is where it will be!
I'll be waiting in Claudia!!

{C:81900600}{C:819582961A3200000000}Once we enter Claudia,
we'll probably face one battle after another.

{C:819582961B3200000000}If there's anything you want,
get it now while you can.
